name: zsnd_play_handle_update3d_a3d
description: zSndPlayHandle::Update3D_A3D updates A3D source position, velocity, gain, and doppler scale for backend play handles.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification was attempted with vc5_o2_ob1_gx_facs, vc5_o2_ob2_gx_facs, and vc5_o2_ob1_md_gx_facs. The closest profile was vc5_o2_ob2_gx_facs with 100 unmasked mismatches after 8 COFF relocation bytes were masked and 4 trailing VC NOP bytes were trimmed; vc5_o2_ob1_gx_facs and vc5_o2_ob1_md_gx_facs each had 160 mismatches. The normalized diff shows source-shape/register drift: the object saves EBX and keeps the A3D source in ESI while retail keeps the play handle in ESI and reloads the source around provider calls; the /Ob1 profiles also emit a FloatFromBits helper call before zSndSample_PlaySimple.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja read-only assembly for 0x4a2a70 validates returning -1 for non-backend handles and null backend buffers, early success when a world position is supplied but the owner sample lacks replay flag bit 0x04, SetPosition through A3D source vtable slot 0x50, SetVelocity through slot 0x80, muted SetGain(0.0f), unmuted SetGain(zSndSample_PlaySimple(gainScaled)), SetDopplerScale(1.0f or 0.0f) through slot 0xb0, and final return 1.

The focused native smoke verifies non-backend rejection, owner-flag early success without provider calls, full position/velocity/gain/doppler update, muted gain zeroing, velocity-scale doppler behavior, and null backend rejection.

The function remains reconstructed with a limited marker because current BN HLIL shows known artifacts for zSnd::IsMuted scratch-register clobbering and x87 float stack handoff; the assembly and smoke evidence cover the source contract.
